fields.description: Import: the operation's response, mapped to documents of the DocType. Export: documents of the DocType, mapped to the operation's request body.
fields.label: Direction

fields.description: Only an Active transform runs, and it runs the rules as they were when it was activated. Changing anything else a sync reads (the operation, the parameters, the expressions, Runtime Validation, the child tables) makes it a Draft again.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The operation's path in the API Spec, as written there: /orders/{id}.
fields.label: Path

fields.description: Where the items are in the response, as a JSON Pointer (/data/items). Empty: the response is the item, or the list of items.
fields.label: Items Pointer

fields.description: JSONata giving an object of the path's parameters: {"id": $syncId("Customer", customer)}. Import: evaluated on {"last_import"}, when the last import in which every item imported began. Export: evaluated on the document.
fields.label: Path Parameters

fields.description: JSONata giving an object of the query parameters: {"updated_since": last_import}. Evaluated as Path Parameters is.
fields.label: Query Parameters

fields.description: JSONata evaluated on the last page ({body, headers, query}): the next page's query parameters, merged into the last ones ({"page": query.page + 1}), or undefined (or an object of nulls only) after the last page.
fields.label: Next Request
Maximum Pages
fields.description: The most pages an import reads in one sync. One that stops here with pages left fails, and the next import reads them.
JSONata giving the object's id in the API. Import (required): evaluated on the item. Export: evaluated on a create's response.
fields.label: External ID

fields.description: JSONata giving when the item last changed: an item no newer than when it was last imported is skipped.
fields.label: Modified

fields.description: Each mapped object is checked against the target's schema when a sync runs: an import's against the DocType, an export's against the request body (an import's response is also checked against the operation, as warnings). Enforce: an object with an error is not saved or sent. Warn: it is, and the findings are logged. Off: nothing is checked.
fields.label: Runtime Validation

fields.description: On an update, Replace sets each mapped child table to the mapped rows; Merge by Key updates the rows with the same key and adds the others.
fields.label: Child Tables

fields.description: For each child table, the JSONata evaluated on a row to give its key: {"items": "item_code"}.
fields.label: Child Table Keys

fields.description: Each rule fills the target field at its pointer: [{"ptr": "/items/qty", "kind": "field", "expr": "quantity"}]. Kinds: field, collection, scalar_collection.
fields.label: Rules

fields.description: The rules as one JSONata expression.
fields.label: Compiled JSONata

fields.description: What runs: the Compiled JSONata as it was when the transform was activated.
fields.label: Active JSONata

fields.description: Source items the transform is checked and dry-run on.
fields.label: Sample

fields.description: What the last save found in the rules.
fields.label: Diagnostics
